Wellhead interface

| Option | Default | Range or values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `showGuide` | `true` |  | Shows the guide tab: the steps from a new wellhead to steam production, and what to do next. |
| `openGuideUntilFirstProduction` | `true` |  | Opens the interface on the guide until the well first produced steam. |
